code: Play it on a PAL (50 Hz) console
effect: Warning screen: "This Game pak is not designed for your SUPER FAMICOM or SUPER NES."
note: The boot check $80:E54B reads $213F bit 4 (PAL) and shows this yellow screen instead of the game. Seen in Mesen with the region set to PAL. A one-byte patch at file $6585 (D0 -> 80) skips the check.

code: Plug a SNES Mouse into either port
effect: Warning screen: "You can not use a mouse with this Game."
note: The same boot check ($80:E54B) shows this when a controller port reports device ID 1 (the SNES Mouse). Seen in Mesen with a mouse in port 2.

code: ROM patch $14897: 82 2A 01 -> EA EA EA, and $10038 / $10048: 4 bytes -> EA EA EA EA
effect: The cut STAGE CLEAR screen after each Story win: CLEAR BONUS, TIME BONUS, then SCORE and TOTAL
note: Every Story win calls $82:C897 (from $81:81A9), whose first instruction is BRL to its own RTL, so the screen is skipped. Its body loads graphics set $D4 and tilemaps $EE and $EF (used nowhere else), fades in, waits for a button, shows the second page, waits again and fades out. Nothing fills in the numbers, so they stay 00000000. Removing the BRL alone leaves a black screen (the object task's RAM routines at $7F:0021 / $7F:0072 hang), so the two calls to them ($10038, $10048) are also NOPed. In Mesen after a forced win: both pages, then the next opponent's intro as normal.

code: Hold L or R + the d-pad on a menu
effect: Scrolls the ぱにっくボンバー pattern behind the menu
note: The menu loop ($80:D588) calls $80:D61D every frame: with L or R held, the d-pad moves the background's scroll ($70E7 across, $70EB down) by 4 a frame. In Mesen on the main menu, 20 frames of L+Right took $70E7 from 128 to 208, and R+Down moved $70EB the same; the d-pad alone only moves the cursor. Looks like a test control left in.
